# SJ Webdev Services

> SJ Webdev Services is an independent web design and development studio founded in 2020 by Sherwin Galindo. It designs and hand-codes modern, responsive websites for restaurants, pubs, salons and service businesses, mainly in Bucks County and the greater Philadelphia area of Pennsylvania, and remotely for businesses across the United States. Every site is custom-built (no drag-and-drop page builders), fast-loading, mobile-friendly and SEO-ready — built to establish a credible online presence and turn visitors into customers. Founded and run by web designer & developer Sherwin Galindo.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** SJ Webdev Services
- **Founder / lead developer:** Sherwin Galindo
- **What we do:** Custom website design and development, landing pages, ecommerce, SEO foundations and ongoing maintenance
- **How we build:** Hand-coded, custom-built websites — not WordPress or drag-and-drop builders — for speed, security and search performance
- **Area served:** Bucks County, PA; Montgomery County, PA; greater Philadelphia; clients nationwide (remote delivery)
- **Typical clients:** Restaurants, pubs and bars, pizzerias and diners, salons, landscapers, home-service and professional businesses
- **Founded:** 2020
- **Track record:** 100+ projects delivered; 38 live client websites listed in the portfolio
- **Pricing:** Fixed quotes; landing pages at the lower end, multi-page business sites in the middle, ecommerce and custom functionality at the top
- **Contact:** sjwebdevservices@gmail.com
- **Consultation:** Free, no-pressure consultation before any project begins; every quote is fixed before work starts
- **Website:** https://sjwebdevservices.com

## Services

- [Website Design](https://sjwebdevservices.com/services/#design): Custom, brand-aligned designs that look professional and build trust.
- [Website Development](https://sjwebdevservices.com/services/#development): Hand-coded, fast and reliable front-end development.
- [Ecommerce Development](https://sjwebdevservices.com/services/#ecommerce): Online stores built to sell, with a smooth checkout experience.
- [Landing Pages](https://sjwebdevservices.com/services/#landing-pages): Focused, high-converting pages for campaigns and launches.
- [Website Maintenance](https://sjwebdevservices.com/services/#maintenance): Ongoing updates, fixes and improvements after launch.
- [SEO Foundations](https://sjwebdevservices.com/services/#seo): Clean structure, metadata and performance so pages can rank.

## Common questions

- **How long does a website take?** Landing pages take a few days; a multi-page business website usually takes one to three weeks depending on scope.
- **How much does a website cost?** It depends on scope — a focused landing page at the lower end, a multi-page business site in the middle, ecommerce or custom functionality at the top. Every quote is fixed before work begins.
- **Why hand-coded instead of WordPress or a builder?** Hand-coded sites load faster, rank better, can't break from plugin updates and are far harder to hack.
- **Do you offer support after launch?** Yes — every project includes a post-launch support window, with optional ongoing maintenance plans.
- **Do you build restaurant websites?** Yes — restaurant, pub and bar websites are the studio's most common projects (menus, online ordering and reservation links, hours and location data search engines can read).
- **Do you work outside Pennsylvania?** Yes — consultation, design review, launch and support all happen online, so the studio works with businesses anywhere in the United States.
- **What is included in a website project?** Discovery, custom design, hand-coded responsive development, on-page SEO foundations (metadata, sitemap, Schema.org structured data), cross-device testing, launch and a post-launch support window.
